fields.PRODUCT NAME: Handcrafted Wooden Love Birds – Rajasthani Decorative Art
fields.DESCRIPTION: Celebrate love, harmony, and togetherness with this beautifully hand-carved wooden love birds sculpture from Rajasthan. Crafted by skilled artisans, the piece depicts two intricately detailed birds facing each other, symbolizing unity and affection. The fine carving work highlights the traditional artistry of Rajasthan, where every cut and curve is done by hand, making each piece unique. This charming creation is perfect for home décor, gifting, or as a symbol of love and companionship.
